Alyssa: Hey team — running into a parity issue between the Python SDK sync and async paths for embeddings + rerank. Sync path returns embeddings as list[float] for a single input, async returns [[float]] (batch wrapper). Onboarding sample app got confusing. Repro below.

Marco: can you paste minimal repro?

Alyssa: sure:
```py
# sync
emb = client.embeddings.create(input="hello")
# emb.data[0].embedding -> [0.1, 0.2...]

# async
emb = await client.embeddings.create(input="hello")
# emb.data -> [[0.1, 0.2...]]
```

Ciara: ugh, that's painful. I think the async batching helper is auto-wrapping singletons for continuous batching. It should probably preserve scalar vs batch shapes or at least document it.

Ben: also saw typing stubs: `Embeddings.create` return annotations differ between sync/async overloads. That leads to VSCode confusion.

Marco: can repro. Also noticed when auth refresh happens (401 -> refresh -> retry) the retry path reserializes request as batch sometimes. Might be a middleware order bug.

sdk-bot: CI run 1790006701: failed unit tests in `test_embeddings` (rerank shape parity) — see https://ci.internal/1790006701

Alyssa: workaround for now is to always normalize: `embedding = emb.data[0] if isinstance(emb.data[0][0], float) else emb.data[0][0]` — gross.

David: Proposal: add param `force_batch: bool = False` to keep consistent output and add typing overloads for scalar vs batch. Also add a helper `unwrap_embedding(emb)` in `redwood.sdk.utils`.

Ciara: agree. Small API change but reduces onboarding friction. Also update quickstart snippets to show both sync/async parity note.

Marco: I'll file issue and tag eng-ml + devex. PR to add utils + typing fixes. Assigning to @marco. issue: RED-3421

Ben: will review typings patch. Can we also add an e2e test that exercises auth refresh + batching middleware order?

Alyssa: thanks. If someone can add a short blurb in the sample app docs that warns about shape changes until patch shipped, that'd help support.

David: created PR draft: https://git.internal/pulls/987 — includes unwrap helper, typing overloads, and a unit test. Needs review.

Ciara: Adding to next sprint. :+1:

Alyssa: awesome — thanks all. keeping this thread for updates.
